step.cmd: Ensure that the Bluetooth device is turned on.
On the taskbar, select the network status icon.

info.p: This icon is typically located at the far right of the taskbar.

step.cmd: Select the Bluetooth icon to view available Bluetooth devices.

info.p: If the Bluetooth icon is not visible, ensure that Bluetooth is enabled in the operating system settings.

step.cmd: Select the Bluetooth device you wish to connect to from the list of available devices.

info.p: Ensure that the device is in pairing mode and within range, typically within 10 meters (approximately 33 feet).

step.cmd: Follow any on-screen instructions to complete the pairing process.

info.p: You may be prompted to enter a passcode or confirm the connection on both devices.

step.cmd: Verify the connection status by checking the Bluetooth settings.

info.p: Once connected, the device should appear as connected in the Bluetooth settings.
